description.value: The apron is a contemporary Canadian farm-to-table restaurant inside the Westin Wall Centre, steps from Vancouver International Airport, serving Pacific Northwest cuisine sourced from local farmers, growers, and fishers. It is led by Executive Chef Clement Chan, a National Chef of the Year and Culinary Team Canada member known from Food Network's Chopped Canada and Top Chef Canada. The setting spans an indoor dining room and terrace, making it a polished full-service stop for cyclists passing through the Richmond/YVR corridor.
